Table Toggle Button Module Server

Source: R/ro_shiny_show_table_module.R
ro_show_table_server.Rd

Server logic for toggling the table visibility button and updating its label/icon.

Usage

ro_show_table_server(
  id,
  svg_path,
  label_show = "Toon tabel",
  label_hide = "Verberg tabel"
)

Arguments

id

Character. The module namespace ID.

svg_path

Character. SVG path data for the icon.

label_show

Character. Label shown when table is hidden. Default is "Toon tabel".

label_hide

Character. Label shown when table is visible. Default is "Verberg tabel".

Value

A list with a reactiveVal show_table, indicating whether the table is shown.

See also

ro_show_table_ui, ro_shiny_graph_panel_server

Other DT: ro_create_custom_button(), ro_icon_download(), ro_icon_table(), ro_shiny_download_server(), ro_shiny_download_ui(), ro_shiny_dt_responsive(), ro_shiny_dt_server(), ro_shiny_dt_ui(), ro_shiny_graph_panel_server(), ro_shiny_graph_panel_ui(), ro_shiny_screenreader(), ro_show_table_ui()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ro_show_table_server(
    id = "toggle1",
    svg_path = ro_icon_table()
  )
}
